description: This file provides language-specific UI strings and configurations for the 'codemirror' plugin within the CKEditor project, specifically for the Serbian Latin script ('sr-latn'). It defines localized labels, tooltips, shortcut instructions, and plugin-specific UI text.

methods.name: setLang
